sections.title: How it works
sections.content: You know the past conditional `ha … volna, … volna` and `kellett volna` from B1 Unit 20, and mixed conditionals from B1 Unit 35. Here they describe what a judge would have done, in a general case: `Ha nem lett volna írott szabály, a bíró az alapelvekből indult volna ki.` New in this lesson is the vocabulary of the reading, including *láthatatlan alkotmány*.

sections.title: Example
sections.content: Example: `Ha a szabály nem lett volna világos, a bíró az alapelvekből indult volna ki.`

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: Ha nem lett volna írott szabály, a bíró az alapelvekből indult volna ki.
If there had been no written rule, the judge would have started from the principles.
A bírónak az alapelveket is figyelembe kellett volna vennie.
The judge should have taken the principles into account too.
Ha a szabály nem lett volna világos, a bíró az alapelvekből indult volna ki.
If the rule had not been clear, the judge would have started from the principles.
